title: feat(home): dismissible 'set recovery password' reminder
body:
Companion to deferring the forced set-password gate. New SSO users go straight to the magic moment; this gentle, dismissible banner on the env home (shown when `hasLocalPassword() === false`) nudges them to set a recovery password — links to /set-password, remembers dismissal in localStorage. Preserves instance self-sufficiency without friction. Browser-verified (shows, dismisses, persists). zh + en.
